notes: Q1 FY27 call (11 Aug 2026) is pending: its promises cover FY27 and later. It is excluded from the score, so the 7 graded events carry weights 7 to 1.

Repeated promises about the same event are graded once at first statement. The Bain closing date was re-forecast as 'another one month' on the Q1 FY26, Q2 FY26 and Q3 FY26 calls, and the branch-approval timing was also repeated. Both are folded into one entry each.
Numeric forecasts that changed from call to call (gold yield) are graded per call against the next reported quarter.
Where a floor target was only partly met, a relative shortfall of 10% or less is scored 1, applying the v1.2 ceiling-overshoot rule by analogy.
The Q4 FY26 transcript on AlphaStreet is marked preliminary. Q2 FY26 is from the company-filed PDF. Q1 FY27 outcomes are from the 11 Aug 2026 NSE investor presentation (slide numbers cited).
No promises were traced beyond the 8-event window (Rule 7); none were retrieved.
The reference to the CEO's health in the Q4 FY26 entry is the Chairman's own public statement on that call.
